failed.pool: Not enough characters in the pool
failed.healer: Not enough healers for both teams
failed.elements: Not enough elements for the rule
failed.fiveStars: Not enough 4★ characters for the rule

cards.timeTrialsHint: Cards that put a time limit on the fight
cards.hardestHint: The hardest cards. A draw holds one at most.

fourElements.title: Four elements
fourElements.text: No two characters share an element.

twoElements.title: Two elements
twoElements.text: The team has exactly two elements.

fourRegions.title: Four regions
fourRegions.text: Every character comes from a different region.

oneFiveStar.title: One 5★
oneFiveStar.text: At most one 5★ character in the team.

oneWeaponType.title: One weapon type
oneWeaponType.text: The whole team uses the same type of weapon.

oneElement.title: One element
oneElement.text: The whole team shares one element.

oneRegion.title: One region
oneRegion.text: The whole team comes from one region.

threeCharacters.title: Three characters
threeCharacters.text: One slot of the team stays empty.

twoCharacters.title: Two characters
twoCharacters.text: Two slots of the team stay empty.

fourStarWeapons.title: 4★ weapons only
fourStarWeapons.text: Every character holds a 4★ weapon or lower.

oneSetForAll.title: One set for all
oneSetForAll.text: The whole team wears the same 4-piece set.

levelOneWeapons.title: Lv. 1 weapons
levelOneWeapons.text: Every character holds a weapon at level 1.

threeStarWeapons.title: 3★ weapons only
threeStarWeapons.text: Every character holds a 3★ weapon or lower.

swapInSlotOrder.title: Swap in slot order
swapInSlotOrder.text: Swap only to the next slot: 1, 2, 3, 4, 1.

noBursts.title: No bursts
noBursts.text: Elemental Bursts stay unused for the whole run.

noSkills.title: No skills
noSkills.text: Elemental Skills stay unused for the whole run.

skillsOnly.title: Skills only
skillsOnly.text: Elemental Skills only. No normal attacks, no Elemental Bursts.

noShields.title: No shields
noShields.text: No shielders and no shield skills.

swapEveryTen.title: Swap every 10 s
swapEveryTen.text: Nobody stays on the field longer than ten seconds.

noSwapping.title: No swapping
noSwapping.text: The character who starts the fight finishes it.

allBurstsTogether.title: All bursts together
allBurstsTogether.text: Elemental Bursts are used only when all four are ready.

nobodyFalls.title: Nobody falls
nobodyFalls.text: The run fails when a character falls.

normalAttacksOnly.title: Normal attacks only
normalAttacksOnly.text: No Elemental Skills, no Elemental Bursts.

chargedAttacksOnly.title: Charged attacks only
chargedAttacksOnly.text: Charged Attacks deal the damage. No Elemental Skills, no Elemental Bursts.

noHealing.title: No healing
noHealing.text: No healers, no healing skills, no food that heals.

noDodging.title: No dodging
noDodging.text: No dashing out of the way.

noHits.title: No hits
noHits.text: Start again when anyone takes damage.

underFiveMinutes.title: Under 5 minutes
underFiveMinutes.text: The fight ends within five minutes.

underThreeMinutes.title: Under 3 minutes
underThreeMinutes.text: The fight ends within three minutes, or it does not count.

firstTry.title: First try
firstTry.text: One attempt. It counts, whatever happens.

threeBursts.title: Three bursts
threeBursts.text: The team uses three Elemental Bursts in all.

underNinetySeconds.title: Under 90 seconds
underNinetySeconds.text: A speed run: ninety seconds on the clock.

pickForNext.title: Pick for the next player
pickForNext.text: Each player picks the next player's character.

oneBurstEach.title: One burst each
oneBurstEach.text: Each player uses their Elemental Burst once.

oneRoleEach.title: One role each
oneRoleEach.text: One healer, one shielder, one main DPS, one support.

oneCaller.title: One caller
oneCaller.text: One player calls every Elemental Burst. Nobody uses one without the call.

noReviving.title: No reviving
noReviving.text: A fallen player stays down until the fight ends.

sameElementEveryone.title: Same element, everyone
sameElementEveryone.text: All players bring the same element.

sameCharacterEveryone.title: Same character, everyone
sameCharacterEveryone.text: All players bring the same character.

burstsInPlayerOrder.title: Bursts in player order
burstsInPlayerOrder.text: Elemental Bursts go 1P, 2P, 3P, 4P, then round again.

noGadgets.title: No gadgets
noGadgets.text: No gadget is used in the fight.

noPausing.title: No pausing
noPausing.text: The menu stays shut during the fight.

sayItOutLoud.title: Say it out loud
sayItOutLoud.text: Say every Elemental Skill and Elemental Burst before using it.

travelerLeads.title: Traveler leads
travelerLeads.text: The Traveler is in the team and lands the last hit.

failAddsCard.title: A fail adds a card
failAddsCard.text: Every failed try draws one more card.
